name: OptiGD
description: High-performance optimization engine and frame-time stabilization mod for Geometry Dash 2.2.

tier-preset.name: Performance Profile
tier-preset.description: Select optimization profile. Default is High Performance (aggressive culling for low-spec/heavy levels).

enable-culling.name: Spatial Frustum Culling
enable-culling.description: Culls offscreen level objects using 2D spatial hash to eliminate redundant CPU/GPU updates.

enable-particle-limits.name: Particle Throttling & Sleep
enable-particle-limits.description: Sleeps offscreen particle emitters and scales cosmetic particle density under load.

enable-adaptive.name: Adaptive Dynamic Governor
enable-adaptive.description: Monitors real-time frame budget and prevents micro-stutters by automatically adjusting fidelity.

show-diagnostics.name: Diagnostics HUD
show-diagnostics.description: Displays live frame-rate, frame-time variance, and culling efficiency statistics.
